name: self-edit
description: Modify Warden's own source code or its voice/UI pipeline, rebuild, and restart. Use when the user asks to change, fix, or add to Warden's behavior in code. Edits src/, container/agent-runner/src/, and the voice/UI pipeline under voice/. Backend changes run npm run build and restart the systemd unit (systemctl --user restart warden); voice/UI changes need no build and take effect on the next voice/run.sh launch.
